# QHooks

<!-- qhooks-discovery-summary -->
Launch, trade & QProof token safety on Robinhood Chain + more; perps, OTC escrow and agreements.

Read supported token/perps markets and stored QProof evidence. Spot plans require a listed route on Base, Robinhood Chain, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB or Elysium. Monad MCP launch, spot planning and QProof are unavailable. Prepare OTC escrow on Robinhood Chain. Prepare pay-when-done agreements on Robinhood Chain. Prepared for the signing wallet: the agent's own wallet or yours. No custody. We never hold keys. MCP launches use site flows. Spot plans require a listed EVM route, or chain solana for an unsigned Jupiter swap the agent's own Solana wallet signs.
<!-- /qhooks-discovery-summary -->

- [Agent discovery](https://qhooks.com/.well-known/qhooks-agent.json): Public tools exposed by the current MCP release.
- [Agent skill](https://qhooks.com/skill.md): One MCP for token/perps reads and unsigned plans for an agent-owned or user-owned signing wallet.
- [API](https://qhooks.com/api): Public REST and MCP documentation.
- [Hooks](https://qhooks.com/hooks): Build with QHooks.
- [Liquidity proof](https://qhooks.com/lp-proof): Launch liquidity evidence.
